verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is itself a terminal-based AI coding agent, and its docs show several ways to hand it work: interactive turns with queued messages, single-task headless runs via `--prompt`, Goals that keep it working until a judge model marks the objective complete, and built-in Explore/Plan/Execute subagents and modes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
